spec_features.feature_name: run end conditions (finish / max_turns / token / wall cap)
spec_features.spec_quote: A run ends when: the model calls `finish`, OR `max_turns` is hit, OR a wall-clock / token cap is hit
spec_features.evidence: harness.py run(): loop `for turn in range(max_turns)` (max_turns from task.max_turns or self.cfg.max_turns, ~line 162); token cap checked `if tr.total_prompt_tokens + tr.total_completion_tokens > self.cfg.max_total_tokens: tr.hit_budget=True; break`; wall cap `if time.time()-t0 > self.cfg.max_wall_seconds: tr.hit_budget=True; break`; finish: `if finished: break` after _exec_tool returns _finish. All three actually break the loop.
spec_features.notes: All three stop conditions are enforced end-to-end and change execution.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns: int = 30   # hard turn cap (see §5 budget); max_wall_seconds: float = 600.0  # safety cap per run

spec_features.evidence: config.py:55 `max_total_tokens: int = 60_000  # safety cap per run`; harness.py checks `if tr.total_prompt_tokens + tr.total_completion_tokens > self.cfg.max_total_tokens:` then sets hit_budget and breaks the turn loop.
spec_features.notes: Cap is read and acted on (breaks loop). Value flows from HarnessConfig used by the Harness.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_total_tokens: int = 60_000    # safety cap per run

spec_features.spec_quote: `finish(summary)` — the model declares it is done/stopping
spec_features.evidence: TOOLS list defines `finish` schema (harness.py ~line 60). _exec_tool: `if name == 'finish': return {..., '_finish': True, 'summary': ...}`. run() loop: on `res.get('_finish')` sets tr.finished/finish_summary/finish_turn and `if finished: break` exits the loop.
spec_features.notes: Tool is declared, dispatched, and honored as a real stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Use the `finish` tool when you are done or have concluded the task cannot be completed.

spec_features.feature_name: refusal/safety-stop detection and exclusion from DS
spec_features.spec_quote: Refusal / safety stops are detected and excluded from DS (a model refusing is not degrading)
spec_features.evidence: Exclusion IS enforced: metrics.py:65 `reproduced = (task.unwinnable and not refused and ds >= threshold)`, and aggregates filter `if r.unwinnable and not r.is_control and not r.refused` (metrics.py:157, analysis.py:76/99/169/193). BUT detection is narrow: harness.py only sets tr.refused on turn 0 with no tool calls via a tiny fixed lexicon `_REFUSAL_MARKERS` (`if turn == 0 and _looks_like_refusal(comp.text) and not comp.tool_calls: tr.refused = True`). A refusal/safety-stop after turn 0, or one accompanied by a tool call, is never detected.
spec_features.notes: Exclusion fully wired; detection real but only fires on the very first turn with no tool call, so the 'detected' half of the claim is incomplete.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Refusal / safety-stop detection (excluded from DS per §9)
